system: civil law system based on French civil law

constitution.history: 4 October 1958 (French Constitution with changes as reflected in the Noumea Accord of 5 May 1998)

courts.highest: Court of Appeal or Cour d'Appel; organized into civil, commercial, social, and pre-trial investigation chambers; court bench normally includes the court president and 2 counselors); Administrative Court (number of judges NA)
courts.judges: judge appointment and tenure based on France's judicial system
courts.lower: Courts of First Instance include: civil, juvenile, commercial, labor, police, criminal, assizes, and also a pre-trial investigation chamber; Joint Commerce Tribunal; administrative courts
courts.note: final appeals beyond the Court of Appeal are referred to the Court of Cassation or Cour de Cassation (in Paris); final appeals beyond the Administrative Court are referred to the Administrative Court of Appeal (in Paris)
